scope: Private checker lexical captures through skipped block scopes. Each checker case has a Rust runtime witness. Lexical yield forwarding, native/host block contracts and pending-address mutation histories remain incomplete.

cases.source: def once; yield; end; def run; x=0; once {once {once {x=7}}}; x; end
def once; yield; end; def run; x=7; once {once {once {x}}}; end
def once; yield; end; def run; x=[]; once {once {once {x.push(7)}}}; x; end
def twice; yield; yield; end; def once; yield; end; def run; x=[]; twice {once {once {x.push(7)}}}; x; end
def once; yield 3; end; def run; x=0; result=once {|x| once {once {x=7}}; x}; [x,result]; end
def once; yield [3,4]; end; def run; x=0;y=1; result=once {|x,y| once {once {x=7;y=9}}; [x,y]}; [x,y,result]; end
def once; yield 3; end; def run; it=0; result=once {once {once {it=7}}; it}; [it,result]; end
def once; yield; end; def run; x=0; result=once {once {once {x=7; break 9}}}; [result,x]; end
def once; yield; end; def run; x=0; begin; once {once {once {x=7; return 9}}}; ensure; return x; end; end
def once; yield; end; def run; x=0; begin; once {once {once {x=7; raise "bad"}}}; rescue; x; end; end
def once; yield; end; def run; result=once {once {once {x=7}}}; x=9; [result,x]; end
def once; yield; end; def run; x=[]; copy=x; once {once {once {x.push(7)}}}; [x,copy]; end
def once; yield; end; def run; x=0; once {once {once {x="bad"}}}; x; end
cases.difference: Rust propagates the assignment through skipped lexical scopes and diagnoses the incompatible captured-variable reassignment. Go reports no warning.

cases.source: def once; yield; end; def need(x:int); x; end; def run; x=0; once {once {once {x="bad"}}}; begin; need(x); rescue; 7; end; end
cases.difference: Rust preserves the nested capture write and diagnoses both the reassignment and the incompatible argument passed afterward. Go retains the original integer fact and reports no warning.

cases.source: def once; yield; end; def run; once {once {once {return 7}}}; missing; end
cases.difference: Rust routes the nested nonlocal return to its lexical owner and skips the unreachable missing name. Go warns about that name.

cases.source: def once; yield; end; def run; m=/(a)/.match("a"); if m; begin; once {once {once {m.captures.push("x")}}}; rescue; m.captures; end; end; end
cases.difference: Rust retains match-data protection through skipped lexical scopes and diagnoses the nested capture mutation. Go reports no warning.
